set.notes: June opened with two claim-level candidates. C14-JUN23-001 is Accepted as C14-2023-0002: guest Rabbi Amnon Yitzhak said Mapai was written on trains taking Jews during the Holocaust. Yad Vashem, quoted by The Seventh Eye, says the Hebrew-writing/extermination-train claim is completely false and identifies the cited Mapai-marked train image as displaced persons in 1947 after the war. The entry is explicitly Guest / interviewee, not Channel 14 editorial speech; Channel 14's disavowal/apology and Yitzhak's later objection to the interpretation are preserved. Exact claim-specific broadcast imagery and a guest-hosted replay were recovered; stable GitHub preview generation and Notion publication are still in progress. C14-JUN23-002 preserves Itamar Fleischman's claim that a reported Jerusalem Day attack on a Palestinian was fake as Pending until the exact Channel 14 date/original segment and exact underlying attack are matched. No adverse verdict is forced.

January is fully processed with one explicit exact-media gap.
